name: Three-mode product: Chat / Work / Codex
what: ChatGPT is split into Chat (fast conversational answers), Work (an agent for long multi-step tasks that returns finished deliverables) and Codex (software development). Web/mobile show a Chat|Work toggle; the desktop app adds a global ChatGPT|Codex switcher.
how: Work is built on the Codex harness and metered like Codex (token-based allowance shared with Codex, Office add-ins and Workspace Agents). Chat uses per-message allowances. Work/Codex have their own model controls (GPT-6 Sol/6.1 Sol/Luna/Astra) separate from Chat.
verevonRelevance: Verevon's chat vs agent pages map directly onto Chat vs Work; the metering boundary (per-message vs token) is a proven way to make agent cost legible.
notes: Launched 2026-07-09. The older 'ChatGPT agent' (virtual computer) was retired in favour of Work.

name: Intelligent UI (generative interactive answers)
what: With GPT-6 in Chat, answers can mix text, graphics, side-by-side comparisons, charts, forms, tappable buttons and small interactive tools (calculators, bill splitters, games, flashcards). The model decides the format and can still answer in plain text.
how: GPT-6 Sol/Luna are trained to compose responses from text plus a library of native UI components; third-party coverage describes components streamed in chunks and a compiler that transforms the interface as it is generated. Some components (checklists) keep state within a thread; state is not shared across threads. Users can reduce visuals via Personalization > Layout and visuals > Simple. Not available in Work, Voice, or at Pro (Astra) effort.
verevonRelevance: Verevon's rendering layer should accept a typed component stream (not only markdown) so the Model Plane can emit widgets; this is the single biggest UX differentiator shipped in Oct 2026.
notes: Rolled out 2026-10-07 (paid) / 10-08 (Free, Go). Implementation detail (component library + compiler) is from third-party reporting, confidence medium for that part.

name: Answer-while-thinking (interleaved reasoning and output)
what: GPT-6 can begin answering while it continues to think or use tools, then append more findings without another prompt, so the user starts reading before the answer is complete.
how: Model-level interleaving of reasoning, tool calls and visible output; OpenAI reports GPT-6 Instant starts answering web-search questions 44% sooner (time-to-first-token) than GPT-5.6 Instant.
verevonRelevance: Model Plane run events should allow partial answer segments interleaved with tool/thinking events rather than a single final message.
notes: 44% is a vendor self-report.

name: Progressive rendering of interactive content and lazy-loaded long chats
what: Interactive experiences appear progressively while still being generated; long conversations load in smaller sections instead of fetching the whole thread.
how: Chunked streaming of interactive content (Aug 21 2026) and paginated message loading on web.
verevonRelevance: Verevon's SolidJS chat should virtualize/paginate threads and render widgets incrementally.
notes: Release note dated 2026-08-21.

name: Interactive charts in answers
what: ChatGPT can turn answers into interactive bar, line, pie and scatter charts inline (ask for one or the model adds it when useful).
how: Native chart widgets in the response renderer (June 8 2026), later subsumed by Intelligent UI; code-block visuals (flowcharts, diagrams) can also be exported as images.
verevonRelevance: Chart widgets as first-class response blocks are table stakes for Verevon.

name: Writing blocks and full-screen document editor (canvas successor)
what: Long-form writing (essays, PRDs, reports) opens in a focused full-screen editor with a wider layout, table of contents, download, undo/redo and save-to-Library. Canvas was removed from GPT-5.5 models; writing and coding are handled in-chat through writing blocks and code blocks.
how: Writing blocks are inline response artifacts that can expand to a document editor; documents persist in Library/Space. Canvas remains only on legacy models.
verevonRelevance: Verevon should treat documents as persistent artifacts tied to the Data Plane rather than a separate canvas mode.
notes: May 28 and June 8 2026 release notes. Quality 3 because the transition left a feature gap (canvas comments/versions not documented for writing blocks).

name: Interactive code blocks with preview and split view
what: Code blocks support in-line editing, previewing diagrams and mini apps directly in chat, and split-screen review; diagram/data-viz output can be exported as images.
how: Sandboxed preview of HTML/React/Mermaid-style output inside the code block (Feb 19 and Feb 27 2026).
verevonRelevance: Preview-in-place for generated code is expected; Verevon needs a sandboxed iframe runtime for previews.

name: Branch conversation from any message
what: Hover a message, choose Branch in new chat, and continue from that point in a separate thread while the original stays intact. In shared projects branched chats appear alongside the original with the creator's avatar.
how: Server-side fork of the message chain; Codex app-server exposes thread/fork with lastTurnId and ephemeral flags.
verevonRelevance: Model Plane sessions need a parent/fork pointer; UI needs branch navigation.
notes: Shipped 2025-09-04 web; mobile later.

name: Edit, regenerate and model-retry menu
what: Users can edit earlier messages including ones with image/file attachments, and regenerate a response with a different model or Thinking/Pro effort from the three-dot retry menu.
how: Retry menu offers Try again / Search the web / Thinking / Pro options; edits re-run the branch.
verevonRelevance: Verevon should allow per-regeneration model/effort override, not only global picker changes.
notes: Feb 27 (edit with images), June 8 (edit with attachments iOS), Mar 17 2026 (simplified retry).

name: Interrupt and steer long-running runs
what: During deep research or Pro-model runs the user can click update in the sidebar and send new information mid-stream; the model adjusts without restarting. In Work/Codex, follow-ups can Steer (append to current run) or Queue (run after).
how: turn/steer with expectedTurnId and turn/interrupt in the Codex app-server protocol; queued messages shown above the composer and reorderable.
verevonRelevance: Model Plane runs should accept mid-turn input injection (steer) and a queue, with a default preference setting.
notes: Nov 5 2025 for deep research; Codex steer/queue Feb 2026 onward.

name: Table of contents for long conversations and reports
what: Conversations longer than five responses get a table of contents; deep research reports open full-screen with a TOC, sources section and activity history.
how: Client-side outline built from response headings.
verevonRelevance: Cheap navigation win for Verevon's long agent threads.

name: Unified search across chats, projects, images and files
what: Sidebar search finds past chats (title and content), projects, images and documents from one place with content-type filters; Library has its own file search.
how: Indexed search over conversations and Library objects; results open the chat/project/file directly.
verevonRelevance: Data Plane retrieval could back a single omni-search for Verevon sessions and documents.

name: Sidebar organization: pins, Recents grouping, filters
what: Chats and projects can be pinned; Recents can be one combined list or grouped by project; on desktop Chat and Work chats appear together with sort/filter/pin; pins sync between desktop and iOS.
how: Per-user sidebar state synced server-side (Android excluded from pin sync at launch).
verevonRelevance: Basic hygiene for Verevon's session list.

name: Projects (chats + files + instructions + sources)
what: Projects group chats, files, and project-specific instructions that override global custom instructions. Sources can be added from Google Drive/Slack links, saved chat responses, or pasted text. Chats can be moved in/out; Work can start from project context.
how: Per-project file limits: Free 5, Go/Plus 25, Edu/Pro/Business/Enterprise 40; max 10 files uploaded at once; unlimited projects. Google Drive sync is not supported inside projects.
verevonRelevance: Verevon spaces should support instruction overrides and heterogeneous sources (links, saved responses, pasted text).

name: Shared projects with chat/edit roles
what: Projects can be shared with invited people, groups, or anyone with a link; invitees get chat or edit access. Owners control members; collaborators can branch chats; leaving offers a copy of your chats.
how: Limits: Pro 40 files/100 collaborators, Plus and Go 25/10, Free 5/5; workspace projects up to 100 collaborators. Shared projects are forced to project-only memory. Group access level and individual overrides resolve to the higher of the two.
verevonRelevance: Verevon's Space ACL model (never widening owner ACLs) is compatible; note the forced memory isolation for shared contexts.

name: Shareable links for conversations, single responses and tasks
what: Users share a whole conversation, an individual response, or a scheduled task via chatgpt.com/share and chatgpt.com/s links. Personal links are anonymous snapshots that can be updated; workspace links are restricted to workspace members and can include later messages. Recipients can continue as a private copy.
how: Link registry under Settings > Data controls > Shared links; no per-recipient ACL or expiry; memory sources are stripped from shared chats; export includes shared_conversations.json.
verevonRelevance: Verevon could beat this with expiring links and recipient ACLs tied to Control Plane identities.
notes: Quality 3: no expiry, no recipient restriction.

name: Space and Pages (collaborative documents)
what: Space replaces Library for Pro/Business/Enterprise: a home for pages, files and folders with a personal space and shared spaces. Pages are editable documents (nested subpages, charts, trackers, interactive tools) that collaborators edit in real time; each person uses their own ChatGPT; comments on selected text request changes.
how: Access inherits from parent page/space; files uploaded into a page inherit page permissions, linked files do not; Slides and Sheets and 'Keep updated' auto-sync are announced as coming. Mobile is read/share only.
verevonRelevance: Directly comparable to Verevon's Application Plane collaborative projections; the 'each collaborator brings their own agent' model is worth copying.

name: Teams (workspace sub-groups with service accounts)
what: A team groups coworkers once so pages, Spaces, plugins and recurring team tasks can be shared with them; teams have their own cloud service account for running tasks with team-configured connections.
how: Team membership separate from admin groups; join links; owner controls connections; RBAC decides who can create teams/tasks.
verevonRelevance: Service-account execution for shared automations solves the 'whose credentials run this' problem Verevon will face for org-level agents.

name: Large pastes become attachments; paste keeps formatting
what: Pasting more than 10k characters converts the content into an attachment (reversible via Show in text field) to keep the composer clean and protect context; pasted text from Google Docs or ChatGPT keeps headings, bold, links and lists.
how: Client-side composer rule; threshold raised from 5k to 10k in 2026.
verevonRelevance: Small but important context-budget safeguard for Verevon's composer.

name: Library: auto-saved files with storage quotas, favorites and sharing
what: Every uploaded or generated file is saved to Library (web), browsable with type filters, recently-deleted restore, favorites/folders, and sharing with Viewer/Editor roles or workspace-wide. Connected Google Drive/Box/Dropbox/SharePoint folders appear inline and files can be kept open beside the chat.
how: Storage: Free 500 MB, Go 4 GB, Plus/Business 20 GB, Pro 100 GB; per-file 512 MB, 2M tokens for text, ~50 MB CSV, 20 MB images; files in temporary chats are not saved; compliance endpoints can export/delete Library files.
verevonRelevance: Verevon's Data Plane should expose a user file library with quotas and side-by-side viewer rather than per-chat attachments only.
notes: Space supersedes Library for Pro/Business/Enterprise.

name: Fast answers (non-personalized cached answers)
what: For common information-seeking questions where no personalization is needed and a high-confidence answer exists, ChatGPT responds faster; such answers do not reference memory. Users can disable Fast answers in Personalization.
how: Routing shortcut for logged-in and logged-out users across plans.
verevonRelevance: A cache/route for generic queries could cut Verevon's inference cost.
notes: Mechanism (precomputed vs cheaper model) not documented.

name: Entity highlights with side panel
what: Answers highlight important people, places, products and ideas; tapping opens a side panel with key facts and trusted sources.
how: Entity linking in the response renderer (Jan 30 2026).
verevonRelevance: Verevon could link highlighted entities to Data Plane graph nodes.

name: Save response as note or to project; Start writing from selection
what: Highlight text in a response and choose Start writing to continue it as a document or save it to Library; in projects, responses can be saved as project sources.
how: Response-to-artifact actions in the message menu.
verevonRelevance: Promote chat output into Data Plane documents with one action.

name: Data export and account deletion
what: Personal accounts can export their data (settings or Privacy Portal) and delete the account; Business/Enterprise/Healthcare users must go through workspace owners; Edu can be admin-enabled.
how: Export includes conversations and shared-link metadata but not scheduled tasks or task-link snapshots.
verevonRelevance: Verevon needs a complete, admin-governed export path (GDPR).

name: Messaging-channel access (WhatsApp, Kakao, Viber, Slack app)
what: ChatGPT is usable by messaging 1-800-CHATGPT on WhatsApp (text, images, voice notes, image creation), on Kakao and Viber, and via a ChatGPT app for Slack whose chats appear in the user's ChatGPT sidebar.
how: Optional account linking raises limits; Slack app supports semantic search on AI-enabled Slack plans.
verevonRelevance: Verevon's Channel Plane is docs-only; ChatGPT shows channels as thin adapters over the same session store.

name: File uploads: documents, spreadsheets, presentations, images
what: Upload DOCX/PDF/TXT, XLSX/XLS/CSV/TSV, PPTX and images; up to 20 files per message; ask to summarize, compare, extract, analyze. Enterprise supports visual retrieval for PDFs (embedded images); other plans use text extraction.
how: Limits: 512 MB per file, 2M tokens per text file, ~50 MB spreadsheets, 20 MB images, 80 files per 3 hours (Free 3/day), 25 GB per user and 100 GB per org shared upload storage.
verevonRelevance: Verevon's ingestion should publish comparable, documented limits and consider visual PDF retrieval.

name: Audio uploads with transcription and summaries
what: Paid users upload recordings (WAV, MP3, OGG, FLAC, AAC, M4A, audio-only WebM/MP4, up to 512 MB) to get transcripts, summaries, structured notes, follow-up drafts and Q&A; long files are chunked best-effort.
how: Server-side transcription plus Data Analysis chunking; speaker identification may be unreliable.
verevonRelevance: Audio-as-document ingestion is a Data Plane feature Verevon can add cheaply.
notes: Launched 2026-10-06.

name: ChatGPT Images 2.5: generation, region editing, templates, sketch, aspect ratios, thinking
what: Create images in any aspect ratio, edit regions with a selection tool or by description, start from templates with follow-up questions, sketch-to-image on mobile, comment on images, share prompt templates; 'images with thinking' plans before drawing on Thinking/Pro models; up to eight consistent images per prompt (2.0).
how: GPT-Image-2 family (API gpt-image-2); C2PA metadata; images saved to an Images tab; Snake game shown during generation on some platforms.
verevonRelevance: Verevon can route to GPT-Image-2 via the Model Plane; region-editing UI and templates are the UX bar.
notes: Templates unavailable in Work mode.

name: Virtual try-on and shopping images
what: A Try on button on clothing listings generates a try-on image from a saved selfie reference photo (managed under Personalization > Reference photos); image search finds similar products.
how: ChatGPT Images with a stored reference image; products saved to Library favorites.
verevonRelevance: Low relevance (consumer commerce); shows reference-image personalization pattern.

name: Voice: Live (full-duplex GPT-Live-1) inside the chat
what: Live voice listens and speaks simultaneously, works inside the normal chat with streamed text, uses web search, memory, plugins and widgets (maps, weather), accepts typed text and images mid-call, and can continue in Work after the call ends. Advanced (video/screen share) and Standard (turn-based) remain selectable.
how: GPT-Live-1 (paid) / GPT-Live-1 mini (Free); limits: Go 3h mini, Plus 3h, Pro100 15h, Pro200 unlimited, Business 3h/15h then 1.25 credits/min; Voice can escalate to GPT-5.6/GPT-6 Astra for hard questions; audio clips retained 30 days; only one voice conversation at a time; spoken approvals not supported.
verevonRelevance: Verevon's realtime voice should be an overlay on the same session rather than a separate mode; escalation to a reasoning model is a good routing pattern.
notes: Voice merged into chat Nov 2025; GPT-Live-1 July 2026.

name: Dictation with improved STT and auto-retry
what: Dictation transcribes a prompt for review before sending; new STT model (June 2026) lowered word error rate at least 10% on top languages and handles code-switching; failed dictation retries once automatically on iOS.
how: Separate speech-to-text model from Voice.
verevonRelevance: Dictation separate from live voice is a cheap, high-use feature for Verevon.

name: Data analysis (code execution for spreadsheets and charts)
what: ChatGPT runs code in a secure environment to clean, analyze, visualize and project data from CSV/spreadsheets; charts and tables open in an expandable view and can be customized and downloaded.
how: Python sandbox ('Advanced Data Analysis'); Free tier has separate limits; Lockdown Mode blocks downloads into the sandbox.
verevonRelevance: Model Plane sandboxes already exist in Verevon; match the expandable chart/table viewer.

name: Work deliverables: documents, spreadsheets, presentations, reports, Sites
what: Work produces finished files (documents, spreadsheets, decks, reports) and interactive Sites, following user templates and instructions; GPT-6 Astra is highlighted for template-following office outputs. Reviewers rate spreadsheets strong, decks/docs needing an editing pass.
how: Codex-based agent with file-generation tools; outputs saved to Library/Space; deliverables created from connected-app context.
verevonRelevance: Verevon agent page must end in artifacts, not chat text; use the same template-following framing.
notes: Quality assessment of outputs is third-party.

name: ChatGPT Sites (hosted websites and lightweight apps)
what: Describe a site in Work or Codex, review a private preview, save versions, deploy to a production URL, share with workspace/external viewers/public, attach custom domains, edit from the published site, and schedule cloud automations to refresh it.
how: Supported runtime with HTTP/HTTPS/WebSockets, D1 relational DB (10 GB/site), R2 object storage, hosted secrets/env vars, optional Sign in with ChatGPT (server receives oai-authenticated-user-email header), .openai/hosting.json for local projects; no data residency; no PHI/payment card data.
verevonRelevance: Comparable to Manus web builder; Verevon could offer sandbox-hosted previews first and defer hosting.
notes: Public beta; not on Free/Go.

name: Office add-ins: ChatGPT for Word, Excel/Sheets, PowerPoint
what: Sidebars inside Word, Excel, Google Sheets and PowerPoint draft, summarize, revise, build formulas, multi-tab files and slides in place, with Skills and apps; available on all plans including Free, metered on the shared agentic allowance.
how: Microsoft Marketplace / Google Workspace Marketplace add-ins signed in with the ChatGPT account; token-based rates on business plans.
verevonRelevance: Verevon's integration-corev2 could expose the same agent inside Office via add-ins later; not core.

name: Learning widgets: flashcards, quizzes, interactive math/science modules
what: Ask for flashcards (flip, mark known/practice, shuffle, saved to library), interactive quizzes answered in-chat, and 70+ interactive math/science modules where variables can be manipulated with live graphs; study mode uses Socratic questioning.
how: Pre-built interactive components invoked by the model; study mode implemented via custom system instructions.
verevonRelevance: Shows value of a curated widget library the model can invoke; Verevon could do this with domain widgets.

name: Meetings plugin (desktop note-taking without a bot)
what: Takes notes for online or in-person meetings from the Mac, produces a personalized summary and action items on a Space page, lets you start an action item with one click, keeps notes private by default; audio is deleted once notes are ready.
how: macOS desktop plugin using transcript + user notes + connected-app context; consent reminder shown only to the host.
verevonRelevance: Meeting capture to action items feeds naturally into Verevon tasks; privacy design (delete audio) is worth copying.
notes: Beta, macOS, Pro/Business.

name: Mobile capture: multi-page scan to PDF, recent photos, lock-screen live voice
what: Camera Scan combines multiple pages into one PDF for upload; long-press + opens recent photos; Live voice content shows on the iPhone Lock Screen/Dynamic Island with background conversations.
how: iOS app features (Oct 1, Aug 21, Aug 31 2026).
verevonRelevance: Mobile capture flows matter if Verevon ships a mobile wrapper.

name: Pronunciation audio and 60+ language guidance
what: Asking how to pronounce a word returns text plus playable audio and a phonetic breakdown in 60+ languages.
how: TTS snippet embedded in the response.
verevonRelevance: Minor; shows inline audio components.

name: Web search with citations, Sources panel and hover previews
what: ChatGPT searches automatically or via /Search; responses carry citations that open the source, hover previews on desktop, a Sources list, image sources and map cards on mobile. Logged-out users can search too.
how: Queries are rewritten into targeted sub-queries sent to partners (Microsoft, Shopify) with approximate IP location but no account data; memory can shape the rewritten query; multiple searches run automatically for complex questions.
verevonRelevance: Quarry-v2 should document what it shares with upstream search providers the same way; memory-informed query rewriting is a good Model Plane pattern.

name: Inline web images in answers
what: Answers include inline images from the web beside the relevant paragraph for people, places and products; clicking shows original size and attribution.
how: Image search results embedded by the renderer; limited in Lockdown Mode.
verevonRelevance: Note the exfiltration angle: web-derived images are a URL-based leak channel, which is why Lockdown blocks them.

name: Deep research with editable plan, site scoping and interruptible runs
what: Start via /Deepresearch, tools menu or sidebar; ChatGPT asks clarifying questions, proposes a research plan you can edit, shows progress, lets you interrupt to refocus or change allowed sources, and returns a cited report in a full-screen view with TOC, sources and activity history; export as Markdown, Word or PDF.
how: Sites > Manage sites restricts to listed domains or prioritizes them; uses public web, uploaded files and read-only actions of connected apps; legacy model selectable; usage counted per task (50 credits on business rate card); deep research activity logged in the Compliance Conversation API.
verevonRelevance: The plan-edit-before-run and source-scoping controls are the transparency features Verevon's research mode should expose.
notes: Redesigned Feb 10 2026; legacy mode removed Mar 26 2026.

name: Connected apps (70+ integrations) with read/write actions and multi-account
what: Apps connect Google Drive/Gmail/Calendar/Contacts, Slack, SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, GitHub, GitLab, Box, Dropbox, Notion, Linear, HubSpot, Canva, Zendesk, OneNote and more; ChatGPT searches, references, takes supported actions and shows interactive cards. Multiple accounts per app (personal and work) can be connected.
how: Apps are packaged inside plugins; invoked automatically or via @mention; read vs write actions gated by permissions; admin-managed sync indexes content in advance; OpenAI-built apps are search-only, custom MCP apps add writes.
verevonRelevance: integration-corev2 provider actions should expose the same read/write split and per-connection permission so the Model Plane can ask before writes.

name: Connected-app subscriptions deliver updates into a conversation
what: A conversation can receive matching updates from an app you asked ChatGPT to monitor (e.g. new Slack channel messages), letting the agent continue work when something changes.
how: MCP Events: server declares events capability, ChatGPT calls events/subscribe with a callback URL and whsec_ secret, server POSTs signed webhooks (Standard Webhooks HMAC, 256 KiB cap), events batched into task runs; available in Work (web/desktop cloud) and dots.
verevonRelevance: A standardized event subscription contract between Verevon's integration plane and Model Plane sessions would enable reactive agents.
notes: Requires MCP protocol 2026-07-28.

name: Shopping research, Instant Checkout and restaurant reservations
what: Shopping research asks clarifying questions and returns a personalized buyer's guide; product comparisons side by side; Instant Checkout buys from merchants in-chat with explicit confirmation; reservation times from OpenTable/Resy/Yelp are shown and bookable.
how: Agentic Commerce Protocol (with Stripe) for merchants; payment goes merchant-direct; reservation partners get name/email only with permission.
verevonRelevance: Low for Verevon's B2B focus; the explicit-confirmation-before-commitment pattern is reusable.

name: Domain spaces: Health and Finances with grounded dashboards
what: Health connects medical records and Apple Health into a separate space with a dashboard and grounded Q&A; Finances connects bank accounts via Plaid and Experian credit scores with spending/net-worth dashboards and a weekly update task; both excluded from training and ads targeting.
how: Separate sidebar spaces with isolated memory/files; Health permission defaults to global plugin permission ('Allow low-risk actions').
verevonRelevance: Pattern of a vertical 'space' with isolated memory and its own dashboard could apply to Verevon domains (e.g. food-safety data).
notes: US-centric; EEA excluded for Health.

name: ChatGPT Work: outcome agent with plan, progress, questions and approvals
what: Give a goal; Work gathers context from apps and files, shows a plan (plan mode approval), runs for a long time in the cloud, asks questions, accepts direction changes, and pauses for approval of important actions; result is a deliverable. Tasks continue while the user is away.
how: Cloud execution on OpenAI-managed computers (cloud browser, cloud network, cloud computer use capabilities); desktop can run locally with local files/apps and sync to cloud; metered by tokens.
verevonRelevance: This is the reference shape for Verevon's agent page: goal, plan approval, live progress, approval cards, artifact result.

name: Local work sync (hybrid local/cloud turns)
what: Start a Work task on the desktop using local files/tools, then continue the same conversation from web or mobile; if the computer is offline a new turn runs in a cloud container without local access; a running turn never silently migrates.
how: Cloud-coordinated conversation with per-turn execution location; requires both Local and Cloud Work permissions; supports data residency and EKM but not ZDR.
verevonRelevance: Verevon's Rust gateway could coordinate turns across a local agent host and cloud sandbox with the same explicit per-turn location semantics.

name: Dots: always-on personal agents with their own cloud computer
what: A dot takes a goal, keeps working between conversations, has its own cloud computer and browser, connects to apps, proactively researches (read-only), forms memories, runs scheduled checks, posts in Slack/Teams with its own identity, can be texted or called, and brings results back for review. Activity is grouped as In progress / Scheduled / Completed; users can take over its computer, pause, or reset it.
how: Powered by GPT-6 Astra; local computer access optional and off by default; custom rules per action (act without asking / if pre-approved / ask / hand off); a separate auto-review system checks consequential steps; first dot included on Pro and Business Premium; Enterprise beta off by default.
verevonRelevance: Closest public analogue to a persistent Verevon agent: per-agent identity, memory, rules, and a long-lived sandbox are the Model Plane primitives to design for.
notes: Launched 2026-09-29; EEA/UK/CH excluded for Pro at launch.

name: Scheduled tasks: one-time, recurring, monitoring, with a Scheduled page
what: Ask for reminders, recurring work or monitoring; a Scheduled page lists tasks with next run, pause/resume/edit/delete; monitoring tasks use prior runs and stop on an end condition and only notify when something matters; notifications via push or email.
how: Active limits: Free/Go 3, Plus 5, Business/Edu 10, Pro/Enterprise 15; Free once per day in flexible windows (morning/afternoon/night); paid up to hourly with exact times; inactive tasks auto-pause; tasks in projects cannot read project files; not usable with Voice or GPTs; Pulse (daily proactive briefing) was folded into tasks.
verevonRelevance: Verevon's Model Plane needs a scheduler with monitoring semantics (state across runs, end conditions, notify-only-on-change).

name: Event-triggered (webhook) tasks from Gmail, Slack and GitHub
what: Work tasks fire on new Gmail messages (filterable by sender/subject), Slack channel messages (@ChatGPT must be in channel) or GitHub PR activity; the task shows Trigger, Condition and Prompt; actions needing approval pause the task.
how: Limits 30 runs/hour and 720/day across all event tasks; events may be grouped; Enterprise admins must enable 'Allow event-triggered scheduled tasks' (off by default); not on Free/Go or FedRAMP; desktop can view but not edit triggers.
verevonRelevance: Trigger/Condition/Prompt is a clean data model for Verevon automations.

name: Shareable task definitions
what: Share an active or paused task; recipients review instructions and schedule an independent copy using their own apps; the link is a snapshot that can be refreshed at the same URL.
how: Snapshot includes title, instructions, schedule, time zone, optional mode/model; excludes creator identity, history, results, memories, files and credentials.
verevonRelevance: Task templates as shareable, credential-free snapshots fit Verevon's no-ACL-widening rule.

name: Team tasks running under a team service account
what: Teams define recurring tasks (schedule or event trigger) that run in the cloud under the team's service account with admin-approved workspace connections; teammates can Run now, review Previous runs, reply inside a run, edit instructions or pause.
how: Task = owning team + name + instructions + trigger + plugins + Advanced (model); can be started from Slack or Microsoft Teams via @ChatGPT.
verevonRelevance: Org-owned automations with a non-personal identity are what Verevon customers will ask for.

name: Workspace Agents (builder, versions, schedules, Slack, API trigger)
what: Business/Enterprise users build agents from a prompt or template, preview, pick model and reasoning effort, add apps, custom MCPs, skills, files (512 MB each, 10 GB per agent), channels (ChatGPT directory, Slack, API), schedules, and share with can-chat/can-edit roles; version history allows republishing an earlier version.
how: Connector auth per app is end-user or agent-owned account; write actions default to Always ask with Never ask/custom options; Connector Action Constraints are natural-language rules compiled into restrictions; API trigger POST /v1/workspace_agents/{id}/trigger returns 202 with conversation_url, optional run tracking (queued/in_progress/suspended/completed/failed).
verevonRelevance: A direct template for Verevon's agent definitions: tools, auth mode, action constraints, channels, versioning.
notes: Multiplayer editing uses save-conflict refresh, not real-time merge.

name: Auto-review: a separate reviewer approves eligible actions
what: Instead of pausing for every approval, a separate reviewer model checks eligible actions; approved actions continue, denied ones make the agent try a safer approach or ask. For dots, auto-review tells the dot why an action was blocked.
how: Settings > Permissions > Auto-review in Codex; free and not counted against usage when signed in with ChatGPT; does not override workspace restrictions.
